title: kith-tslocal: whois() null-byte check omits node.name
description: kith-tslocal/src/lib.rs:349-355 — whois() checks user_profile.id and user_profile.login_name for null bytes but not WhoIsNode.name, which becomes mailbox_host in the DB. The stated rationale (SQL/string safety) applies equally. No current exploit path (is_valid_fetch_host would reject a null-byte host), but the validation is inconsistently applied. Fix: add null-byte check for result.node.name after the existing checks at line 355.
